source.source_text_reference:
CATEGORIZE AF
• Paroxysmal AF: Episodes of AF for
less than 7 days
• Persistent AF: AF lasing from 7
days to 1 year
• Long standing perssistent AF: AF
lasting for > 1 year
• Permanent AF: AF with heart rate
control as only option
source.review_notes: Typographical variant 'lasing' for lasting
